caveats: Experimental CAS adapter, not production Sprig or feature parity.
Unsupported metadata-branch probe omitted from BOTH products.
CAS initialization is included in import; actual FUSE readiness charged to first fork.
CLI checkpoint process startup versus SDK in-process calls is included and disclosed.
Both active workspace lifecycles are retained at physical sampling; each view has its own live FUSE lower.
Kernel caches affect warm reads; FUSE processes have separate userspace caches; no cold-cache or equivalent-memory claim.
Full runtime accounting includes comparator Docker writable layers and persistent daemon roots.
Checkpoint durability differs; final accounting sync outside timers does not establish equivalence.
